description: Implement 4 UX improvements: (1) KnowledgeBase multi-file upload + show uploaded files list, (2) TextInput/PhaseContent show success confirmation and AI response after submit, (3) Validate Coherence button hidden until user submits input, (4) Advance button shows contextual message explaining why it's blocked.
steps: STEP 1 - KnowledgeBase multi-file upload + document list: In frontend/src/api/client.ts, add a `getKnowledgeDocuments()` function that calls GET /api/knowledge/documents and returns {documents: string[], total: number}. In frontend/src/components/KnowledgeBase.tsx: (a) change the file input to accept `multiple` attribute, (b) update handleUpload to loop over all selected files and upload each via uploadKnowledge(), (c) add state for `documents: string[]`, (d) on component mount (useEffect), call getKnowledgeDocuments() and populate the documents state, (e) after successful upload, re-fetch the document list, (f) render the list of already-uploaded documents in a visible section (below the upload area). Use the existing .md,.docx,.xlsx accept filter.

STEP 2 - Show success confirmation and AI response after submit: In frontend/src/api/client.ts, the submitInput function currently returns Promise<WorkflowStatus> but the backend actually returns {phase, result, message}. Create a new type SubmitInputResponse = {phase: string, result: Record<string, any>, message: string} in types/research.ts. Update the submitInput function return type to Promise<SubmitInputResponse>. In frontend/src/hooks/useWorkflow.ts, the useSubmitInput hook already calls submitInput - no type change needed there since useMutation infers. In frontend/src/pages/Project.tsx, capture the result from submitInput mutation (submitInput.data). Pass the submitResult data down to PhaseContent as a new prop. In frontend/src/components/PhaseContent.tsx, accept a new optional prop `submitResult?: {phase: string, result: Record<string, any>, message: string} | null`. When submitResult is truthy, show a success message card with a green checkmark and display the result.message ('Input processed successfully'). If submitResult.result.identified_problem exists (phase 1), display it in a styled card showing the AI-identified problem.

STEP 3 - Validate Coherence button: In frontend/src/pages/Project.tsx, the 'Validar Coherencia' button is always visible. Add a condition: only show it if workflow.current_tasks has at least one completed task OR if the current phase has data submitted (i.e., submitInput.data is truthy or submitInput.isSuccess). The simplest approach: track whether the user has submitted at least once via submitInput.isSuccess state. Wrap the validation section in a conditional that checks this flag. Alternative: check if phase_data exists for the current phase in the workflow status - but since phase_data is not currently returned in the status endpoint, use the simpler approach of checking submitInput.isSuccess.

STEP 4 - Advance button contextual message: In frontend/src/components/PhaseContent.tsx, below the advance button, when workflow.can_advance is false, display a helpful message. The logic: if workflow.coherence_validated is false AND phase has data (submit was successful), show 'Primero valida la coherencia de esta fase'. If no data has been submitted yet (submitResult is null/undefined), show 'Primero envia informacion para esta fase'. Use a text-sm text-amber-600 style for the message with an info icon.
acceptance_criteria: KnowledgeBase component shows a list of previously uploaded documents fetched from GET /api/knowledge/documents
KnowledgeBase file input allows selecting multiple files and uploads each one
After submitting text in any phase, a green success confirmation appears with the message
In phase 1 (problem_identification), after submit the AI-identified problem text is displayed
The Validate Coherence button is hidden until the user has submitted input
When the Advance button is disabled, a contextual message explains why (need to submit or need to validate coherence)
Frontend build succeeds with no TypeScript errors
Existing frontend tests continue to pass
verification: Run `cd frontend && npm run build` and confirm no TypeScript errors
Run `cd frontend && npm test` and confirm all existing tests still pass
findings: All 4 steps implemented. STEP1: Added getKnowledgeDocuments() to client.ts (GET /api/knowledge/documents returns {documents, total}); KnowledgeBase now has a `multiple` file input that loops uploading each file via uploadKnowledge(), fetches the document list on mount with useEffect, refetches after upload, and renders a 'Documentos cargados' list. Input value is reset after upload so re-selecting the same files re-triggers onChange. STEP2: Added SubmitInputResponse type ({phase, result: Record<string, any>, message}) to research.ts; fixed submitInput return type from WorkflowStatus to SubmitInputResponse. Project.tsx passes submitInput.data as new submitResult prop to PhaseContent, which renders a green success card with the message and, when result.identified_problem exists (phase 1), a card showing the AI-identified problem. STEP3: Validar Coherencia button block is now wrapped in `submitInput.isSuccess` so it is hidden until the user submits. STEP4: PhaseContent shows an amber contextual message with an Info icon below the advance button when can_advance is false: 'Primero valida la coherencia de esta fase' if a submit succeeded but coherence not validated, else 'Primero envia informacion para esta fase'. Added PhaseContent.test.tsx (5 tests). Verified: `mise exec -- npm run build` succeeds, `mise exec -- npm test` passes 15/15. Node is via mise (not on default PATH), as noted from FEAT-001.
